subject.title: Control UI: Pinned context panel for user-defined persistent facts

question: Should pinned user facts be a first-party Control UI memory feature now, folded into the broader memory-file panel, or deferred until Control UI plugin contribution slots define panels?
rationale: Current main only supports raw allowlisted file editing, while the requested feature changes persistent context and sensitive user data behavior; storage, freshness, injection, and security semantics require maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Keep canonical pinned-facts design
options.body: Use this issue to settle pinned-fact storage, injection, stale-fact, diff-preview, and security behavior before any implementation PR is queued.

options.title: Fold Into Memory Panel
options.body: Treat pinned facts as part of the broader MEMORY.md/USER.md editing effort and close or merge this issue only after that item explicitly covers structured facts and injection freshness.

options.title: Defer to plugin panel seam
options.body: Wait for the Control UI plugin contribution-slot direction if maintainers want memory/context panels to be plugin-contributed rather than bespoke core UI.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical pinned-facts design
recommendation.body: Use this issue to settle pinned-fact storage, injection, stale-fact, diff-preview, and security behavior before any implementation PR is queued.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses Control UI, gateway file access, context injection, and product/security boundaries where Peter has the strongest recent routing signal.
